source:
시방카 (시바견 차) 가질려면 30로벅스 내야함 특징:방귀부스터 (속도:8/10 지구력:8/10)

그룹가입: 사자도리카 특징: 갈기로 악어도리카 물기 공격 막기 (속도:5/10 지구력:10/10) or 악어도리카 물기 (속도:9/10 지구력:4/10

좋아요 누르면 시방오토바이. (시바견 오토바이) 특징: 방귀 부스터 (속도:8/10 지구력:6/10)

친구 초대하면 코닉세그. 특징: 비행기 엔진으로 하늘 날기 (속도: 7/10 지구력: 3/10)

나머지 차: F1 cars. (모두 속도와 지구력: 1/10과 1/10


게임이름: battle of the racing cars (레이싱카들의 대결)

레이싱 코스: 5가지 1:탕후루 asmr course 2:두쫀쿠 asmr course 3:팝잇 asmr course 4:왁뿌볼 asmr course 5:키캡 asmr course
게임이름: battle of the racing cars (레이싱카들의 대결)

answers.ask: Are these lap circuits or point-to-point sprints? Nothing in the prompt says whether a race is timed laps or a single run.
answers.answer: 각 ASMR 코스는 한 바퀴를 도는 랩 서킷으로 만들고, 레이스는 1랩 완주 방식으로 해주세요.

answers.ask: How long should one lap be, given the cars range from very fast to very slow?
answers.answer: 한 랩은 작은 맵에서 약 1~2분 안에 완주할 수 있는 짧은 길이로 해주세요.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] shape — Q: Are these lap circuits or point-to-point sprints? Nothing in the prompt says whether a race is timed laps or a single run. A: 각 ASMR 코스는 한 바퀴를 도는 랩 서킷으로 만들고, 레이스는 1랩 완주 방식으로 해주세요.
- [author] scale — Q: How long should one lap be, given the cars range from very fast to very slow? A: 한 랩은 작은 맵에서 약 1~2분 안에 완주할 수 있는 짧은 길이로 해주세요.

## Enriched image prompt
Create five separate small racing maps, each built as a short closed circuit completed in exactly one lap and intended to take about 1–2 minutes. Give the five maps distinct ASMR-inspired identities named Tanghulu, Dujjonku, Pop-it, Wakppubol, and Keycap, while keeping the same readable racing structure on every map: one starting grid, a marked start-and-finish line, a continuous vehicle corridor, guarded edges, and clear bends returning to the launch straight. Preserve open overhead clearance above each circuit for the special aircraft-engine car that can fly, but keep the legal race volume aligned with the track so lap detection cannot be bypassed. The different unlock conditions, vehicle statistics, purchases, group membership, likes, and friend invitations are mechanics and should not appear as course scenery.

## Genre
The dominant and only genre is Racing. Each map is a finite one-lap vehicle circuit, regardless of the different car abilities and unlock systems.

## Shape and preset
Use `route-circuit`, named Path (Lap Circuit), as the shared top-level form and the shape of each of the five separate course maps. The matched preset is Circuit Racing, retaining its starting grid, lap detection, guardrails, and closed-loop bends.

## Config requirements
Use the visible half of `startpoint-line` for each map's combined start-and-finish marking. Use `lane-corridor` for each continuous legal race corridor, `barrier-guardrail` for physical edge containment, `path-turnaround` for bends closing each loop, and the visible half of `spawn-grid` for aligned car starts. Use `volume-open` for a bounded overhead race envelope that accommodates the flying car without becoming an unrestricted shortcut.

## Layout requirements
Place five `startpoint-line` markers, five `spawn-grid` launch fronts, and five `trigger-finish` detectors, one set per map. Place `trigger-lap` volumes at every map's combined start-and-finish line and after its major bends, extending through the permitted flight height to prevent aerial bypasses. The single completed lap ends the race. Vehicle unlocks, purchases, stats, likes, invitations, and booster behavior require no additional layout placements.

## Layout components
There are five `map` segments: Tanghulu ASMR Course, Dujjonku ASMR Course, Pop-it ASMR Course, Wakppubol ASMR Course, and Keycap ASMR Course. Each uses `route-circuit` as a compact closed loop with one launch straight, several readable bends, physical guardrails, and an overhead race envelope. The five maps do not coexist on one surface and share no traversable connection. Each composition shows the full loop at once while expressing only its named object-theme identity.

## Render order
Use `authored_plan`: generate each of the five connected closed circuits in code first, then produce its top-down and isometric themed views. The authored plan is authoritative because every loop must close, support one valid lap, and place anti-cut detection coherently.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
The scale band is medium for each course, driven by a short vehicle circuit completed in 1–2 minutes while guardrails and grid positions remain legible. The theme is a set of five playful ASMR object-inspired course worlds. `P6` is mandatory for valid closed-loop racing structure, `P4` is required because the five courses are separate maps, and `CHECK` is required for the bounded aerial race volume used by the flying car.

clarifications.ask: Are these lap circuits or point-to-point sprints? Nothing in the prompt says whether a race is timed laps or a single run.

clarifications.ask: How long should one lap be, given the cars range from very fast to very slow?
clarifications.answer: One lap should be short enough to finish in about 1–2 minutes on a small map.
